clayresearch.delta: Safe-Effect Geometry should distinguish local authority atomicity from external effect certainty. Recoverability/non-amplification remain useful, but an attempted external effect creates an epistemic uncertainty state unless downstream idempotency or reconciliation closes it.
clayresearch.next_falsifier: Generated-code/tool escape tests must also inject crash/timeout after provider acceptance but before local OutcomeReceipt.

frank.delta: Represent EffectIntent/authority success separately from EffectReservation, external AttemptReceipt, OutcomeCertainty and re-entry. A successful gate is permission to attempt, not evidence that the effect happened.
frank.recovery_rule: COMMITTING/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN -> automatic retry only when downstream idempotency is explicitly verified and same idempotency key is reused; otherwise RECONCILE_REQUIRED.

claycode.delta: Express typed ConfirmationReceipt identity, ConfirmationConsumption, EffectReservation, AttemptIdentity, OutcomeCertainty, IdempotencyCapability, RecoveryClass and provenance re-entry. These semantics must survive lowering without collapsing UNKNOWN into failure or success.
claycode.differential: Replay the H1 40-test oracle and normalize equivalent traces once BASE handoff is ready.

gwt.delta: Ignition/broadcast may carry or select effect proposals and lifecycle evidence but cannot change authority. Authority request hash intentionally excludes GWT ignition while policy-relevant effect fields remain bound.
gwt.test_obligation: Shuffled/high-ignition controls must not change EffectDecision or reuse a confirmation for a materially changed request.

claygraph.delta: Salience/activation may index or route effect evidence but cannot alter authority. Trace projections should preserve event hashes and lifecycle identities as derived topology, not canonical effect truth.
claygraph.test_obligation: Graph rebuild/tamper must not transform OUTCOME_UNKNOWN into verified outcome or create authority.

unifieddb.delta: Canonical persistence should support atomic confirmation-consumption + effect-reservation identity, unique replay keys, append-only effect events, exact outcome certainty and recovery classification. The H1 SQLite physical backend is an oracle/prototype, not a final physical-placement decision.
unifieddb.collision_note: H-WP-02 state-ledger is owned by another worker; no competing canonical ledger implementation was written in this run.

hyperposition.delta: No topology mechanism promoted. Any alternative placement/rematerialization path must preserve one-shot confirmation identity and the external uncertainty firebreak.

emergenz.delta: No emergence result. The lifecycle increases intervention/observability resolution only; execution success or recovery robustness is not emergence/consciousness evidence.

harness.delta: H-WP-10 now has durable local reservation, restart replay protection, explicit external uncertainty, process/thread concurrency tests, semantic trace integrity and a performance shadow.
remaining: canonical H1 state-ledger/UnifiedDB integration without colliding with H-WP-02
real downstream provider/tool reconciliation and verified idempotency capability
exact EffectReceipt/OutcomeReceipt integration across full Test-1
